What about Annalie? She’s a nice girl. A little perverted, but more or less not harmful.
And she’s strong enough to kick his ass if he tries anything stupid.
Oh man… {{wi}}I really don’t want to ask her to do it… It’s so cringe, but I already told him I will try, I can’t give up without trying. 
Next time I go to Annalie I will try bringing up the topic, but no promises!
